title: CrossFit Potrero Hill

services.name: Drop Ins
services.desc: Visiting from another CrossFit affiliate? Welcome to CrossFit Potrero Hill. Join a regularly scheduled class and experience one of San Francisco’s longest-standing CrossFit communities. We want visiting athletes to have a safe, smooth and enjoyable training experience. Visitor drop-ins are reserved for CrossFitters who have been exposed to regular CrossFit training, are currently training and are comfortable with the movements posted in today’s WOD. If you are unfamiliar with CrossFit and would like to try a regularly scheduled class, we cannot accommodate that as a visitor drop-in.
